detail: Elected departmental councillor for the canton of Yssingeaux (serving with Madeleine Dubois); resigned in 2017 after his election to the National Assembly.

role_sought: Member of the National Assembly, Yvelines 2nd constituency
detail: Elected with the support of La République En Marche!, defeating outgoing LR deputy Pascal Thévenot with 58.3% in the second round.

role_sought: Member of the Regional Council of Île-de-France
detail: Elected to the Regional Council of Île-de-France on the La République En Marche! list led by Laurent Saint-Martin.

role_sought: Member of the National Assembly, Yvelines 2nd constituency
detail: Re-elected with 64.27% of the second-round vote. After being appointed minister, his substitute briefly sat in the Assembly.

role_sought: Member of the National Assembly, Yvelines 2nd constituency
detail: By-election triggered by the resignation of his substitute Anne Grignon over a legal incompatibility; won with 71.67% against NUPES candidate Maïté Carrive-Bedouani.

role_sought: Member of the National Assembly, Yvelines 2nd constituency
detail: Re-elected under the Ensemble banner with 72.69% in the second round; subsequently elected chair of the Foreign Affairs Committee before being reappointed Foreign Minister.
